clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Great-father Winter hears children's wishes during the Feast of Winter Veil. Hired by Smokywood Pastures, he brings holiday cheer near Grommash Hold in the Valley of Strength, though the work wears on him.

Greatfather Winter in the Valley of Strength is an orc performer hired by the Smokywood Pastures merchant company. Ancient lore tells of a majestic elemental spirit who wanders the land, bringing snow and seasonal renewal, but the figure in Orgrimmar promotes company wares and entertains Horde children. Some critics say the commercial mascot cheapens genuine seasonal traditions. Still, few deny the festive excitement he brings to the city streets.

Greatfather Winter works outside Grommash Hold, beneath decorated evergreens. Children climb onto his lap to tell him what gifts they want, while he promotes Smokywood Pastures discounts and offers holiday greetings. The long shift wears him down. He admits he keeps festive spirits in his pack to quiet the noise when work ends, and visiting adventurers bring him snacks to help him endure.
